Nagymama-négyzet (03 §8)

Abbreviations
beg – beginning
ch – chain
ch-sp – chain space
dc – double crochet
sl st – slip stitch
st(s) – stitch(es)

Stitch key
chain (ch)
slip stitch (sl st)
double crochet (dc)
chain space (ch-sp)
magic ring (MR)

Nagymama-négyzet
Magic ring.
Rnd 1: ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), 2 dc in ring, ch 2, [3 dc in ring, ch 2] 3 times (12 sts). Join with sl st to top of beg ch.
Rnd 2: 2 sl st, sl st in next ch-sp, ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), 2 dc in same ch-sp, ch 2, 3 dc in same ch-sp, ch 1, [3 dc in next ch-sp, ch 2, 3 dc in same ch-sp, ch 1] 3 times (24 sts). Join with sl st to top of beg ch.
Rnd 3: 2 sl st, sl st in next ch-sp, ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), 2 dc in same ch-sp, ch 2, 3 dc in same ch-sp, ch 1, 3 dc in next ch-sp, ch 1, [3 dc in next ch-sp, ch 2, 3 dc in same ch-sp, ch 1, 3 dc in next ch-sp, ch 1] 3 times (36 sts). Join with sl st to top of beg ch.
